conclusions.recalibration_required: the current C6-42 simulation reservation (9.17 GiB per 1024^2/153-patch job) refuses both target shapes on every observed live budget; measured per-child peak RSS is 0.72-0.77 GiB (>11x conservative). The recalibration must be shape-aware (pixel-proportional coefficient validated at 1024^2 AND a larger shape, plus an explicit safety margin), preserve plan_phase_admission reject semantics, the ResourceAdmissionError surface, and the public API exactly.
conclusions.review_gate: recalibration is a scheduling-policy amendment to the accepted C6-42 decision: independent review required before acceptance; alternatives (per-shape measured table vs pixel coefficient; margin size) addressed in the Stage-B protocol; login-node refusal behavior must be preserved (12x2 still refuses inside the small shared cgroup budget).
conclusions.margin_arithmetic: at 12 workers: measured 12 x 0.77 = 9.2 GiB children + gdal cache ~4.8 GiB + parent ~0.4 GiB ~= 14.4 GiB against live budgets 36.7-50.8 GB; a 3x per-child margin (2.31 GiB/child -> 27.7 GiB + 5.2 = ~33 GiB) still fits every observed compute-node budget and still refuses on the login node's 2.1-2.4 GB
